ideas.title: XFAB: EU-listed Si photonics foundry flagged as undervalued vs. POET
ideas.summary: An X account highlights XFAB (EU-listed SiC/GaN/MEMS/Silicon Photonics foundry) as trading below replacement P/B value at a $1.7B market cap, backed by both EU and US CHIPS Act payments. The comparison is drawn against POET's $2.4B market cap, which has only a single $50M pre-production contract, suggesting XFAB offers superior value per fundamental asset base.

ideas.title: ZETA: Held alongside NOW/MDB in software basket with active trim-and-reload strategy
ideas.summary: An investor discloses holding ZETA as part of a software basket (alongside NOW and MDB), with ~20% of the software allocation trimmed a few days prior on the rally. The strategy is buy-dips/sell-rallies, implying ZETA remains a core position but with tactical sizing adjustments.

ideas.title: KRKNF: Kraken Robotics pitched as small-cap defense autonomy / undersea warfare play
ideas.summary: Multiple posts from the same X account initiate coverage on Kraken Robotics (KRKNF), citing it as a key part of the Anduril supply chain and a pure-play on undersea warfare and uncrewed systems — themes the market is currently paying up for. Pitched as a small-cap way to gain exposure to defense autonomy secular growth.

ideas.title: SIVE: Multiple X accounts pitch as primary NVLink CPO laser supplier
ideas.summary: Sivers Semiconductors ($SIVE) is pitched as the confirmed laser supplier to Ayar Labs (which just joined NVIDIA's NVLink Fusion ecosystem) and high-confidence supplier to Marvell Celestial and Lightmatter — positioning it as the reference laser source across the NVDA/MRVL CPO ecosystem. The bull case: all NVLink ecosystem partners use GFS (germanium-free substrate) where SIVE is the reference laser, making it a near sole-source gen-1 CPO play. One poster suggests a $6-8B valuation would not be surprising given the supply chain validation.

ideas.title: FTC: Pitched as cleanest listed Starlink ground-network spend proxy
ideas.summary: FTC (Frequency Electronics or similar Starlink ground-network play) is pitched as the purest listed exposure to Starlink's ground-network spending, with a SpaceX IPO expected to serve as a re-rating catalyst. No price target provided.

ideas.title: SIVE/XFAB: EU Chips Act 2.0 launch highlights European photonics names
ideas.summary: The EU Tech Sovereignty Package went live June 3, 2026, with CHIPS Act 2.0 explicitly prioritizing photonics. Both SIVE and XFAB are named in the Industry Policy Blueprints guiding EU legislation, suggesting potential sovereign backing and policy tailwinds for European semiconductor/photonics names.

ideas.title: AOSL: Trader long calls at 52-week high, flags power semi setup
ideas.summary: Alpha and Omega Semiconductor ($AOSL) hit a 52-week high; one trader is long Dec 2026 $60 calls, describing it as not their favorite in the power semiconductor space but still holding. No detailed fundamental thesis provided beyond the technical breakout.

ideas.title: SIVE/SIVEF: X account pitches optical-component rerun of LITE's $3B→$75B run
ideas.summary: One X account argues SIVE can replicate LITE's EML/pluggables-driven surge using CPO, pluggables, and coherent wave technology, noting SIVE was already up 54% on the day following Sivers/GFS silicon photonics reference laser news. The pitcher views the move as the early stage of a broader optical component cycle, with SIVE starting from a similar ~$3B market cap base as LITE did.

ideas.title: XFAB: X account pitches as early-stage TSEM analog in silicon photonics
ideas.summary: An X account highlights XFAB (sub-$2B market cap) as reminiscent of early TSEM, citing NVDA and NOK validation of its pre-commercial silicon photonics foundry and CHIPS Act grants subsidizing capex. The pitcher frames it as a government-backed, customer-validated foundry play at an early inflection point.

ideas.title: STM: X account initiates long via 2028 calls, citing Jensen Huang diligence
ideas.summary: One X account disclosed a long position in STM via January 2028 $95 calls, arguing that Jensen Huang's public validation effectively does the due diligence for investors. No price target given, but the multi-year options structure implies a long-dated fundamental thesis tied to NVDA's supply chain.

ideas.title: DOCN: X account highlights rapid GAI/GPU buildout as impressive
ideas.summary: An X account flagged being highly impressed with how quickly and deeply DigitalOcean (DOCN) has built out its generative AI and GPU-cloud capabilities, framing it as a positive setup, though no explicit price target or rating was given.

ideas.title: UMAC: Roth raises PT to $40, cites potential government funding
ideas.summary: Roth Capital is out positively on Joby Aviation competitor UMAC (Unusual Machines), raising its price target to $40 and highlighting potential government funding as a key catalyst. UMAC is a drone/UAV hardware play that would qualify as tech-adjacent autonomous/defense tech.

ideas.title: SIVE/GFS: GlobalFoundries partnership targets $25B pluggable optics market via Sivers laser arrays
ideas.summary: Sivers Semiconductors (SIVE) surged ~63% after announcing a partnership with GlobalFoundries to advance AI data center optical solutions using Sivers' laser arrays on GFS's silicon photonics platform. The collaboration targets the SCALE optical engine solution set and addresses a claimed $25B pluggable optics market opportunity.

ideas.title: SIVE: X accounts pitch long on CPO laser chokepoint thesis
ideas.summary: Multiple X accounts are bullish on Sivers Semiconductors ($SIVE), pitching it as a critical laser chokepoint in the co-packaged optics (CPO) supply chain. A new strategic collaboration with GlobalFoundries on silicon photonics integration was announced, with SIVE reportedly embedded in reference designs for major hyperscaler chip vendors. Separately, at Computex Taiwan, the CPO supply chain was highlighted via Wiwynn's AyarLabs TeraPHY-based AI accelerator, framing SIVE as a key upstream supplier ahead of CPO ramp.

ideas.title: MCHP: X account pitches long on FPGA criticality for AI/defense buildout
ideas.summary: An X account argues FPGAs are underappreciated for generative AI infrastructure buildout across power management, networking, and control planes, as well as defense applications. The author is long Microchip Technology ($MCHP) January 2028 calls at the $150 strike as a multi-year play on FPGA demand acceleration.

ideas.title: INFQ: X account pitches Infleqtion long on quantum-to-space catalyst
ideas.summary: An X account highlights Infleqtion ($INFQ), a private/quasi-public quantum computing name, pitching its Tiqker quantum atomic clock for space applications as a near-term commercial catalyst. Separately, a valuation comparison notes Infleqtion generated $9.5M in revenue last quarter vs. RGTI's $4.4M, suggesting RGTI's ~$90 per forward sales dollar multiple is stretched relative to INFQ's fundamentals.

ideas.title: IQE: X account highlights multi-month long from ~$12 to $54
ideas.summary: The author flags IQE (European semiconductor materials name) as a standout long, rising from roughly $12-13 to $54 over ~4 months, noting it was the only European semiconductor stock green on the session amid broader sector volatility.

ideas.title: SIVE: X account pitches long vs. new short-seller attack
ideas.summary: Author disputes a new short report on SIVE, arguing the short-seller misunderstands SIVE's customer relationships — specifically that Marvell (Celestial) has been a direct SIVE laser customer since 2023, not routing through POET as an intermediary. Author also notes SIVE is a likely supplier for next-generation glucose monitoring, further broadening the bull case beyond optical interconnects.

ideas.title: FLNC: X account pitches long on Vera Rubin AI data center power architecture win
ideas.summary: Fluence Energy (FLNC) partnered with NVIDIA and Siemens to develop a UL-aligned reference power architecture for the NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 AI factory design, with shares up ~36% on the news. The pitcher notes 2 likely hyperscaler deals in the pipeline, framing FLNC as a direct AI infrastructure power beneficiary.

ideas.title: AMPX: X account pitches long on drone/silicon anode battery thesis
ideas.summary: An X account (author 1425501982320701442) flagged a May 8 entry into $AMPX, citing US government exploration of direct investment in the drone supply chain and AMPX's exposure to silicon anode batteries and defense contracts. Shares were up 25-27% on the day of the post, validating the thesis in the near term.

ideas.title: SIVE: X account pitches long on CPO/photonics, targets $80B+ market cap
ideas.summary: Author 1940360837547565056 calls $SIVE the most compelling co-packaged optics/photonics exposure available, drawing a valuation analogy to LITE's scale and targeting an $80B+ market cap. The author has not sold shares and plans to increase ownership, treating it as a high-conviction position.

ideas.title: ARBE: X account highlights 12x YoY revenue growth in Q1 2026
ideas.summary: Author 1425501982320701442 flagged ARBE's Q1 2026 earnings showing 12x year-over-year revenue growth to $0.5M, describing it as 'seriously impressive.' While the absolute revenue base remains small, the growth trajectory is cited as a bullish signal for this radar-tech name.

ideas.title: TRT: @athuinvests pitches long as AMD-driven 5X opportunity
ideas.summary: An X account pitches TRT as a potential 5X stock, citing AMD as the most likely #1 customer with high conviction. No price target or financial metrics provided, but the thesis centers on AMD customer concentration driving outsized revenue growth.

ideas.title: INFQ: @CoffeeStocksGuy pitches long vs. IONQ on valuation disconnect
ideas.summary: CoffeeStocksGuy questions why INFQ and IONQ trade at identical forward P/S multiples despite different fundamental profiles, implying INFQ is relatively undervalued. The pitch is a relative-value long on INFQ against IONQ.

ideas.title: CML: @CoffeeStocksGuy pitches long on RF semiconductor misvaluation
ideas.summary: CoffeeStocksGuy published a research report on CML, an RF semiconductor name trading below book value and mispriced as a cyclical. The stock has risen 37% in 13 days since the report, with an additional 10% gain on the morning of this post.

ideas.title: INFQ: X account flags valuation discount vs IONQ despite similar P/S multiples
ideas.summary: An X account argues INFQ trades at an unjustified parity forward P/S multiple relative to IONQ, given IONQ's $64.7M quarterly revenue versus INFQ's $9.5M. The implicit pitch is that INFQ may be overvalued at the same multiple, or alternatively that the market is mispricing the revenue scale gap — framed as a relative value short on INFQ or a long on IONQ's premium deserving recognition.

ideas.title: COHU: X pitch — new all-time highs after post-earnings consolidation
ideas.summary: An X account flagged COHU (semiconductor test & inspection equipment) breaking to new all-time highs following a post-earnings sell-off and digestion period. The setup is described as a classic consolidation-then-breakout pattern, with no specific price target given.

ideas.title: ZETA: X account flags higher-low formation and accumulation setup
ideas.summary: An X account (@aglchandan / 2025018027859910656) highlights ZETA as a new setup to watch, citing a higher-low formation, accumulation, and growing revenue as early-stage indicators. The pitch is primarily technical with a bullish directional bias.

ideas.title: DY: Dycom Industries moving on Bloomberg report
ideas.summary: Dycom Industries (DY) shares were noted as moving on a Bloomberg update, suggesting a catalyst-driven price reaction. No further fundamental thesis details were extractable from the item.
